# Introduction

Black forges are base structures used for crafting and repairing Mistlands and Ashlands gear. They require a roof and 70% cover to be usable. Repairing items does not cost any resources.

## Upgrades

Upgrading a Black forge enables additional crafting recipes and higher upgrade levels for items. A Black forge can be upgraded up to level 5 by building the following structures near it:

• Name: Black forge cooler | Materials: 5 Iron5 Copper4 Black marble

• Name: Vice | Materials: 5 Iron8 Copper2 Mechanical spring

• Name: Metal cutter | Materials: 5 Black marble5 Flametal5 Ashwood4 Charred bone

• Name: Gem cutter | Materials: 5 Flametal8 Ashwood2 Morgen sinew1 Bloodstone
